booting.text: One second — the desk is still opening.

no_login.text: Let's open your account. I'll need you to sign in — email, passkey, whatever you like. It's the one pop-up you'll see in this building.

why_login.text: Signing in creates a wallet for you that you control. We never see the key; it lives in a secure enclave. Technically: a Privy embedded wallet — its address becomes the owner of your account.

consent.text: One more thing. Would you like our tellers to act on your instructions without you signing every slip? You can revoke this here any time.

choices.text: Yes, let tellers act for me

why_delegate.text: You'd be adding our branch as a signer on your wallet, limited by a policy to signing bank slips for your own account. Nothing else. Technically: a scoped Privy session signer — typed data for the Bloxchain domain pinned to your account's address, plus the three vault transactions pinned to that same address.

client_mode.text: No problem — tellers will ask you to sign each slip. You can change your mind at this desk.

open.text: Ready to open your account? It takes a moment: Creating account · Registering services · Approving payees · Ready.

loading.text: Let me look {short_wanted} up on the ledger.

enter_action.working: Checking the account holder on that account…

loaded.text: That one's yours — I've put it on your file. Your passbook now reads {short_address} on the {wing} wing, with {balance} practice dollars in it.

why_load.text: Your wallet can hold more than one account contract. The desk normally files the newest one it can find, so an older account — with its own balance, or a wire still cooling — sits there unused. Hand me its number and I'll make that the account this branch works from. I check the ledger first: the account has to say you are its holder, on this wing, or I can't take it. Technically: the desk reads owner() on the address and compares it to your signed-in wallet, then re-points your signing rules at the new contract and re-runs the same checks as a re-check — no new account is created and nothing changes hands.

why_open.text: Your account is its own smart contract, cloned from the branch template and initialised with you as owner, our desk as broadcaster and a {timelock} cooling period. Then we register the transfer service, whitelist the demo token and grant the roles — two selectors each, the function and its handler.

done.text: Done. Here's your passbook. Your account lives at {short_address} on the {wing} wing, with {balance} practice dollars in it.

console_open.text: Console is on the desk screen. Close the panel when you're done.

why_passbook.text: The balance is the demo token's balanceOf your account; the pending count is getPendingTransactions. Re-checking runs the provisioner again — it reads the chain first and only sends what's missing. Top up practice dollars is a separate request that restores a spent balance from the branch treasury, up to the opening amount.

revoked.text: Revoked. From now on the tellers will ask you to sign each slip yourself.

start_over.text: Let's take it from the top.
